thread:
Emily Chen: quick hosted-api roadmap sync — Q2 planning. need a decision on where to put engineering focus: embeddings low-latency (customer asks for sub-30ms p99), chat/completions latency improvements (enterprise SLA asks ~200ms p99), or rerank quality-first with quantized fallbacks. proposing: embeddings fast-path + chat prefix caching in slice A, rerank + quantization tuning in slice B. can folks call out major blockers + launch criteria by thursday?

Raj Patel: embeddings p99 <30ms on hosted is ambitious. which region/hardware are customers expecting? with A100/garbage-prewarm + per-tenant pinned capacity we can approach it, but requires kernel-level optimizations + reduced batch windows. we need an eval harness.

Lina Gomez: agree with raj. also want to flag prefix/KV caching for chat — that buys p99 improvements without huge cost increase. per-tenant prewarm (warm pools) helps embeddings too. tradeoff is higher reserved capacity cost.

Samir Rao: lightweight launch criteria proposal: 1) embeddings: p99 <= 40ms on target hw for 80% of test tenants; 2) chat: p50 <= 80ms, p99 <= 200ms on typical customer mix; 3) rerank: MRR improvement >= 6% vs baseline after quantized model evaluation; 4) cost delta cap: <= 1.25x baseline for high-performance tier. owners + measurement plan due by friday.

Tomás Ortiz: console/UX note — we should expose a simple toggle: fast vs economy for hosted routes. mockup uploaded: https://intranet.redwood/design/fast-economy-toggle (small). also need copy for devex about expected perf/cost tradeoffs. :mag:

Raj Patel: for eval harness, example benchmark command we can standardize:

```
./bench_latency --model embed-xl --concurrency 8 --seq 1 --measure p50,p95,p99 --tenants sample_set.json
```

Also we should add quality checks for quantized rerank: run 100 curated prompts and assert no >4% drop in NDCG.

Emily Chen: thanks — i'll stitch this into the roadmap doc. proposed allocation: Q2 slice A (embeddings low-latency + chat caching + console toggle prototyping), slice B (rerank quantization + canary rollout plan). timeline: scoping doc by Fri EOD, perf harness infra ticket by eng-infra by next tuesday, design copy by tomas by wednesday. @Samir you okay with the cost delta cap?

Samir Rao: OK with that cap for slice A. need an escalation path if enterprise customer signs an SLA requiring tighter numbers earlier.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: embed-lowlatency v2 -> staging at 1708765480 (will run 1k sample requests over 30m).

Lina Gomez: note: if canary shows tail issues we'll require a fallback to economy variant automatically; need routing policy.

Emily Chen: decision for now: prioritize embeddings low-latency + chat latency in Q2 slice A; rerank is slice B. action items: owners assigned in roadmap doc, measurement plan attached, launch criteria as samir suggested. i'll ping for any late major customer news. :thumbsup:

Raj Patel: I'll draft the perf harness PR and link test datasets.

Tomás Ortiz: i'll push console mockups and microcopy tomorrow.

Samir Rao: leaving this thread — thanks team.

Emily Chen: thanks everyone — will update the roadmap doc and close the loop in product sync on friday.
